title: Bespoke Kitchens
description: Handcrafted kitchen designs tailored to your lifestyle and space.
heroDesc: Handcrafted kitchen designs tailored to your lifestyle, cooking habits, and aesthetic preferences.
overview: Our kitchens are designed from scratch to perfectly suit your home. Every cabinet, worktop, and fitting is tailored to your exact requirements. We use only premium materials and finishes, ensuring your kitchen not only looks stunning but stands the test of time. From contemporary handleless designs to classic shaker styles, we bring your vision to life.
overviewShort: Designed from scratch for your room, built from premium materials, and fitted to last.

process.desc: We visit your home, measure the space, and discuss your vision, lifestyle needs, and budget.
Our designers create photorealistic 3D renders. Choose from hundreds of finishes, handles, and worktop materials.
Your kitchen is precision-manufactured in our workshop to exact specifications.
Our experienced fitters install everything to the highest standard, typically within 3-5 days.

pricing.desc: Quality fitted kitchen with standard finishes
Fully bespoke with the finest materials

title: Fitted Bedrooms
description: Elegant bedroom furniture designed for comfort and functionality.
heroDesc: Transform your bedroom into a serene retreat with bespoke fitted furniture.
overview: Create the bedroom of your dreams with our bespoke fitted furniture. From elegant wardrobes to perfectly proportioned bedside units and dressing tables, we design spaces that feel truly personal. Every piece is crafted to maximise your space while creating a luxurious, hotel-like atmosphere.
overviewShort: Wardrobes, bedsides and dressing tables made to fit your room exactly.

process.desc: We assess your space, understand your storage needs, and discuss your style preferences.
3D designs showing every detail, from internal configurations to external finishes.
Each piece is manufactured to exact measurements for a perfect fit.
Professional fitting with minimal disruption, typically completed in 1-2 days.

title: Media Walls
description: Stunning media walls that become the heart of your living space.
heroDesc: Create a stunning focal point with a custom-designed media wall.
overview: Transform your living space with a bespoke media wall that integrates your TV, sound system, fireplace, and storage into one breathtaking design. Our media walls are crafted to be the centrepiece of your home, combining functionality with stunning aesthetics.
overviewShort: TV, sound, fire and storage built into one wall as the centrepiece of the room.

process.desc: We discuss your entertainment setup, room layout, and design preferences.
See your media wall in photorealistic 3D before we build it.
Precision-built in our workshop and finished to your chosen specification.
Professional installation including all electrical connections and media setup.

title: Fitted Wardrobes
description: Floor-to-ceiling wardrobes maximising every inch of space.
heroDesc: Maximise every inch with floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes.
overview: Our fitted wardrobes are designed around your exact wardrobe needs with intelligent internal configurations. From sliding doors to walk-in designs, we maximise every centimetre of space while creating a beautiful, organised storage solution.
overviewShort: Fitted to the centimetre, with an interior configured around what you actually hang.

process.desc: We measure your space precisely and discuss your storage requirements in detail.
Design the perfect layout: hanging space, shelves, drawers, and accessories.
Choose from sliding, hinged, or bi-fold doors in over 50 finishes.
Our expert fitters install your wardrobe seamlessly, usually in just 1 day.
